parameters.note: This special regulation applies to the Trinity River from the confluence with Tangle Blue Creek (Hwy. 3) downstream to the mouth of Trinity Lake, approximately 13.8 miles.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Two-period season: take season from the Saturday preceding Memorial Day through September 30, then catch-and-release with artificial-lures-barbless gear from October 1 through the Friday preceding Memorial Day

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: 5 trout daily bag limit during the summer take season (Sat. preceding Memorial Day through Sep. 30); possession limit equals one daily bag limit (5) per the general provision at 14 CCR §7.50(a) absent a separately stated possession limit.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily bag limit during the Sat. preceding Memorial Day through Sep. 30 take season

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: 0 trout — catch-and-release only from Oct. 1 through the Friday preceding Memorial Day.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: During the fall/winter catch-and-release period (Oct. 1 through the Friday preceding Memorial Day), only artificial lures with barbless hooks may be used. No gear restriction beyond the statewide default applies during the summer take season.

candidates.summary: Artificial lures with barbless hooks required Oct. 1 through the Friday preceding Memorial Day

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document lists this reach (Trinity River, above Clair Engle Lake) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a release month range of June through August; the live CDFW Fish Planting Schedule corroborates actual weekly plants of trout on this water during 2025.
